name: AZZ Inc.
summary:
AZZ (AZZ) reported earnings of $2.00 per share on revenue of $486.89 million for the fiscal second quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.82 per share on revenue of $461.79 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.90 per share. The company beat expectations by 5.26% while revenue grew 16.68% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it now expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP earnings of $7.00 to $7.30 per share on revenue of $1.825 billion to $1.875 billion. The company's previous guidance was non-GAAP earnings of $6.75 to $7.15 per share on revenue of $1.800 billion to $1.850 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $7.06 per share on revenue of $1.820 billion for the year ending February 28, 2027.

Tom Ferguson, President, and Chief Executive Officer of AZZ, commented, "Our record second-quarter sales of $486.9 million, up 16.7%, reflects not only strong execution but also the strength of our long-term strategy and the durability of our business model. Across our Metal Coatings and Precoat Metals segments, we continue to invest in strategic capabilities, operational excellence, and targeted growth initiatives that reinforce our competitive advantages and create sustainable value for our customers and shareholders. During the quarter, we benefited from organic sales growth, the continued ramp-up of our new Washington, Missouri facility within our Precoat Metals segment, and the completion of a strategic Metal Coatings acquisition in the Pacific Northwest."

AZZ Inc is an specialty electrical equipment manufacturer and provides engineered services to the global power generation, industrial, transmission and distribution markets. It also provides galvanizing services.
subject: AZZ Beat Expectations, Raises Guidance In-line with Estimates

name: Citigroup Inc.
summary:
Citigroup (C) reported earnings of $2.85 per share on revenue of $45.63 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.66 per share on revenue of $23.66 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $2.84 per share. The company beat expectations by 0.35% while revenue grew 4.08% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said in its earnings presentation it now expects 2026 NII, ex-Markets, of $90.76 billion to $91.10 billion. The company previously guided NII, ex-Markets, to $89.48 billion to $90.33 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $95.51 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Citi is a preeminent banking partner for institutions with cross-border needs, a global leader in wealth management and a valued personal bank in its home market of the United States.
subject: Citigroup Beat Expectations, Raises NII Guidance

name: Albertsons Companies, Inc.
summary:
Albertsons Companies (ACI) reported earnings of $0.34 per share on revenue of $18.89 billion for the fiscal second quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.31 per share on revenue of $18.83 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.34 per share. The company reported in-line with expectations while revenue fell 0.11% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company is withdrawing its previous guidance for fiscal year non-GAAP earnings of $1.75 to $1.85 per share on revenue of $81.93 billion to $82.76 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.79 per share on revenue of $81.73 billion for the year ending February 28, 2027.

Albertsons Companies is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States, with both a strong local presence and national scale.
subject: Albertsons Companies Reported In-line with Expectations, Albertsons Withdraws Guidance

name: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.
summary:
The Goldman Sachs Group (GS) reported earnings of $17.01 per share on revenue of $37.70 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $12.90 per share on revenue of $16.87 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $12.95 per share. The company beat expectations by 31.35% while revenue grew 17.25% on a year-over-year basis.

Goldman Sachs Group Inc is a investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Its segments include Investment Banking, Trading and Principal Investments, Asset Management and Securities Services.
subject: The Goldman Sachs Group Beat Expectations

name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
summary:
JPMorgan Chase (JPM) reported earnings of $5.75 per share on revenue of $76.19 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $5.94 per share on revenue of $52.21 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $6.10 per share. The company missed expectations by 5.74% while revenue grew 5.97% on a year-over-year basis.

Jamie Dimon, Chairman and CEO, commented on the financial results: “The Firm reported another quarter of strong results, generating net income of $15.8 billion and an ROTCE of 21%, excluding discretionary investment securities losses totaling $498 million after tax. Each line of business performed well."

JPMorgan Chase & Co is a financial services firm and a banking institution. its segments are Consumer & Community Banking, Corporate & Investment Bank, Commercial Banking, and Asset Management.
subject: JPMorgan Chase Missed Expectations

name: Wells Fargo & Company
summary:
Wells Fargo (WFC) reported earnings of $1.87 per share on revenue of $33.26 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.85 per share on revenue of $22.15 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.93 per share. The company missed expectations by 3.11% while revenue grew 4.25% on a year-over-year basis.

Wells Fargo & Co is a diversified financial services company. It provides retail, corporate and commercial banking services through banking stores and offices, the internet and other distribution channels to individuals, businesses and institutions.
subject: Wells Fargo Missed Expectations

name: Johnson & Johnson
summary:
Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) reported earnings of $2.59 per share on revenue of $25.40 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.53 per share on revenue of $25.44 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $2.93 per share. The company missed expectations by 11.60% while revenue grew 5.86% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it now expects 2026 non-GAAP earnings of $11.05 to $11.15 per share on revenue of $101.0 billion to $101.4 billion. The company's previous guidance was non-GAAP earnings of $11.60 to $11.75 per share on revenue of $100.3 billion to $100.9 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $11.08 per share on revenue of $101.2 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

“Johnson & Johnson’s strong third-quarter performance and increased sequential growth reflect the accelerating momentum of our focused portfolio,” said Joaquin Duato, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “In the third quarter, we advanced breakthroughs that will redefine care for patients, from delivering one of our most transformative MedTech innovations with OTTAVA to reporting positive Phase 3 results in multiple myeloma. This progress, together with strategic investments in high-growth areas, gives us clearer line of sight to double-digit growth by the end of the decade.”

Johnson & Johnson is a holding company, which is engaged in the research and development, manufacture and sale of products in the health care field within its Consumer, Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices, and Diagnostics business segments.
subject: Johnson & Johnson Missed Expectations, Revises Guidance

name: FB Financial Corporation
summary:
FB Financial (FBK) reported earnings of $1.21 per share on revenue of $260.65 million for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.21 per share on revenue of $180.14 million. The company reported in-line with consensus estimates while revenue fell 1.10% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

FB Financial Corp is a bank holding company. It operates through its wholly owned banking subsidiary, FirstBank. The company provides commercial and consumer banking services to clients. It operates primarily in Tennessee, North Alabama and North Georgia. The company also provides national mortgage business. FB Financial Corp is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee.
subject: FB Financial Reported In-line with Estimates

name: Domino's Pizza, Inc.
summary:
Domino's Pizza (DPZ) reported earnings of $4.60 per share on revenue of $1.19 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $4.33 per share on revenue of $1.17 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $4.38 per share. The company beat expectations by 5.02% while revenue grew 3.36% on a year-over-year basis.

"As I step into the CEO role, I am honored to lead Domino's and build on the competitive advantages that have long set us apart: our iconic brand, best-in-class franchise system, global scale and proven operating capabilities," said Joe Jordan, Domino's Chief Executive Officer. "Our opportunity now is to capitalize on those strengths by getting even closer to our customers, helping our franchisees grow their profitability and turning our best performance into our everyday performance. By advancing winning ideas faster and executing them with greater clarity, speed and consistency, we can earn more occasions, continue gaining market share and create meaningful long-term value for shareholders. Domino's has always been at its best when we are a step ahead. That mindset has helped us set the pace for the industry before, and it's how we'll push ourselves to do it again. I believe our next chapter will be our strongest yet."

Domino' Pizza Inc is a chain of pizza restaurant. The Company is engaged in retail sales of food, sales of food, equipment & supplies to Company-owned & franchised Domino’s Pizza stores, & receipt of royalties & fees from Domino’s Pizza franchisees.
subject: Domino's Pizza Beat Expectations

name: Unity Bancorp, Inc.
summary:
Unity Bancorp (UNTY) reported earnings of $1.51 per share on revenue of $52.35 million for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.49 per share on revenue of $35.66 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 1.34% while revenue grew 10.61% on a year-over-year basis.

Unity Bancorp, Inc. is a one-bank holding company incorporated to serve as a holding company for First Community Bank. The company's primary business is ownership and supervision of the bank. The company, through the Bank, conducts a traditional and community-oriented commercial banking business, and offers services including personal and business checking accounts and time deposits, money market accounts and regular savings accounts.
subject: Unity Bancorp Beat Consensus Estimates

name: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated
summary:
UnitedHealth Group (UNH) reported earnings of $4.69 per share on revenue of $112.69 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $4.12 per share on revenue of $111.38 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $4.60 per share. The company beat expectations by 1.96% while revenue fell 0.41% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it now expects 2026 non-GAAP earnings of at least $20.50 per share. The company's previous guidance was non-GAAP earnings of $19.50 to $20.00 per share. The current consensus earnings estimate is $19.85 per share for the year ending December 31, 2026.

“Our third quarter results reflect the discipline and execution our teams are bringing to every part of our business, as we continue evolving UnitedHealth Group to deliver a simpler, more supportive experience for patients and the clinicians who care for them,” said Stephen Hemsley, chief executive officer of UnitedHealth Group.

UnitedHealth Group is a health care and well-being company with a mission to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone through two distinct and complementary businesses.
subject: UnitedHealth Group Beat Expectations, Raises Guidance
